desc: Build and host-verify a flash-ready 1 GiB GPT/ext4 Alpine 3.24.0 aarch64 USB-root image with recorded disk/PARTUUID/filesystem identities, DockChannel no-login root shell, no modules/firmware dependency for boot-critical built-in drivers, and no block-device access. Document exact flash and M4 boot boundary; do not rerun unchanged right-port enumeration or touch SPMI/HPM.
author: codex
